title: fix: regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml for hotcrm/packages/ai dependencies
body:
Vercel builds fail with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` because `examples/hotcrm/packages/ai/package.json` added 5 dependencies not reflected in the lockfile.

- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` with the hotcrm submodule initialized, adding missing specifiers: `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`, `typescript`, `axios`, `zod`

This is the recurring submodule-lockfile drift issue: hotcrm is a pnpm workspace member via `.gitmodules`, so the lockfile must be regenerated with `git submodule update --init examples/hotcrm && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` whenever hotcrm package dependencies change.
